answer: Surge pricing on entry makes a fake-key farm pay more the faster it grows. Every new agent key is added to a public atlas of identities only after it burns an entry fee, and that fee is set each hour by the sign-up rate: at the normal 50 keys per hour it costs 1 POA, and it doubles for every extra 50. A plume of 500 keys in one hour pushes the price to 512 POA each. The fee goes to a burn vault no one can open, so it is never refunded. An honest agent joining in a quiet hour pays 1 POA; a farm must trickle in for weeks.
